_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::mixture#0. The sum-to-one rule holds but the entry got both the quantity and the remedy wrong. The input is MASSFRAC — mass fractions (UPSTREAM_USES_VOLFRAC=0) — and no pre-processing check is needed because MIX_Rule_Simple validates it itself: on upstream mixture_elast_hyper_dynamic.4C.yaml, changing the fractions to sum to 0.8 or to 1.3 aborts from SimpleMixtureRule::setup() with 'Mass fractions at element 0 sum to <value> instead of 1.0, which is unphysical.' in src/mixture/src/4C_mixture_rule_simple.cpp, exit 1, in both directions. No stress is ever evaluated, so the predicted 'total > sum of constituents' artefact cannot occur. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C.
expect_in_output: Mass fractions at element 0 sum to 0.8 instead of 1.0, which is unphysical.

_mutation.note: remove the pathology from the under-sum arm: leave the fractions summing to one. The rule's own check passes, EXIT_UNDER becomes 0 and the diagnostic vanishes, so the fixture must go red.
remove the pathology from the over-sum arm: leave the fractions summing to one. EXIT_OVER becomes 0 and the unphysical-sum line vanishes, so the fixture must go red.
